caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate goblet placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The goblet features a wide rim with a metallic or golden band near the top edge. The body of the goblet is primarily colored in deep blue, adorned with white oval and circular patterns, as well as vertical blue panels containing small gold dots or floral motifs. The goblet narrows towards the stem, which continues the blue and white motif, with additional rounded and elongated shapes in blue outlined by white. The base of the goblet is flared and also displays alternating blue and white elongated shapes arranged radially. The lighting and shading indicate a three-dimensional form, and the artwork emphasizes the reflective and decorative qualities of the goblet’s surface. There are no other objects or elements in the composition.
title: Vase
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
